侍.def: to serve, to attend upon; servant, attendant; samurai

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 寺 (temple) as the sound: a person who serves and attends on someone.

侍.name: attendant

origin.says: Simplified from 穎 (頁 became 页): 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 顷 (a moment; 匕 over 页) as the sound, with 禾 tucked under the 匕. The tip of a grain ear; sharp, clever.
王 (jade) for the meaning plus 𧴪 (small shells, from 小 small over 贝 shell) as the sound: the tinkle of small jade pieces, hence petty, trifling. Simplified from 瑣.
A drawing of two low hills side by side on the ground: a mound, a hill. Related in look to 山 (mountain), but not to 兵 or 斤.

株.def: root, stump; measure word for trees

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 朱 (once 'tree trunk') as the sound: a tree trunk or stump; now a measure word for trees and plants.

株.name: tree stump

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 定 (settle) as the sound: shallow lake water where silt settles. It also took over 澱 (sediment) in simplification.
Simplified from 慚: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 斩 (to chop) as the sound: a feeling of shame.
Two 朿 (thorn) side by side: a thicket of thorns, thorny jujube bushes.

搁.def: to place, to lay down; to delay

origin.says: Simplified from 擱 (閣 became 阁): 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 阁 (pavilion) as the sound: to put down, to lay aside, to shelve.

搁.name: put down

ety.hint: To tear something 分 with both hands 手

origin.says: 分 (to divide) between two 手 (hand): two hands pulling something apart, to break off with the hands. A recent character.

悯.def: to pity, to sympathize with; to grieve for

origin.says: 忄 (heart) for the meaning plus 闵 (to grieve) as the sound: to pity. Simplified from 憫 by writing 門 as 门.

悯.name: compassion

ety.hint: A man wearing a helmet, now meaning "pouch"

origin.says: A cover around a head 皃 (head shape) on a person: a helmet or hood. The covering sense led to 'pouch, pocket'.
纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 周 (circuit) as the sound: silk cloth, satin. Simplified from 綢 (糹 to 纟).
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 果 (fruit) as the sound: the counting word for trees and plants, a variant of an older character.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 唐 (Tang) as the sound: an earth bank, and the pond it holds.

ety.hint: The sap 氵 of the varnish tree 桼; 桼 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 氵 (water) plus 桼 (a lacquer tree dripping sap) as the sound and sense: the tree's sap used as varnish; water was added later.
辡 (two quarrelling convicts) as the sound, split around 瓜 (melon) for the meaning: first melon seeds, then a segment, a petal.

ety.hint: Picture of hair 尸 above an eye 目

origin.says: A drawing of hair 𠃜 above an eye 目 (eye): the eyebrow.

揽.def: to grasp; to monopolize; to seize

origin.says: Simplified from 攬: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 覽 (look over) as the sound, now 览: to grasp with the hand, to take on.

揽.name: gather in arms

ety.hint: A nest 巛田 built in a tree 木

origin.says: A drawing of chicks (巛 at the top) in a nest (田-like) up in a tree (木 (tree)): a nest. Nest and tree together now look like 果 (fruit), unrelated.

搂.def: to embrace, to hug; to drag, to pull

origin.says: Simplified from 摟: 手 (hand) for the meaning plus 婁 (Lou) as the sound, written 娄: to gather in with the arms, to hug.

搂.name: scoop up

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 祘 (to count) as the sound: garlic.

囊.def: bag, purse, sack; to pocket, to stow

origin.says: Originally a picture of a tied bag with things inside. In the modern form the top keeps the tied bag and the bottom became a shortened 襄 (assist), read as the sound, so the build is now hard to see.

囊.name: sack

熏.def: to smoke, to cure meat; vapor, smoke, fog

origin.says: Bronze forms draw a bag of things hung over 灬 (fire) to be smoked: to smoke, to cure. The upper part has run together into one shape.

熏.name: smoke-cure

origin.says: Simplified from 鴿: 合 (join) as the sound plus 鳥 (bird) for the meaning: the pigeon or dove. 鳥 (bird) is written in its short form 鸟.
Early forms draw a kneeling woman holding a child to her breast: 'breast, milk, to suckle'. The modern shape has broken into 孚 (to brood) plus 乚 (hook stroke), which only recalls the hand and child.

ety.hint: Aged 昔 wine 酉; wine gone sour

origin.says: 酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 昔 (former times) as the sound: vinegar, wine gone sour; from that, jealousy.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 龙 (dragon) as the sound: to gather together. Simplified from 攏, with 龍 written 龙.
月 (here flesh) for the meaning plus 支 (branch) as sound and meaning: the limbs, the branches of the body.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 平 (level) as the sound, which also gives the sense: level ground, a flat plain.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 巠 as the sound: a stem, stalk. Simplified from 莖, with 巠 written 𢀖.

腔.def: chest cavity; a hollow in the body

origin.says: ⺼ (flesh) for the meaning plus 空 (empty) as sound and meaning: a hollow in the body, the chest cavity; then tone of voice.

腔.name: body cavity

origin.says: 艹 (grass, plant) for the meaning plus 怱 (hurried) as the sound: the scallion. The traditional 蔥 had the older form 悤 of the sound part.
共 (together) as the sound plus a town part (邑 town in one reading, 己 self in another), now shortened to 巳: a lane or alley in a village.

ety.hint: To sell 卖 a soul for money 贝; 卖 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 贖: 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus a sound part that came to look like 賣 (sell): to pay to get back, to ransom. The simplified form writes it 卖 and 貝 贝.

卸.def: to unload; to lay down; to resign

origin.says: 午 (pestle) as the sound with 止 (foot), squeezed into the left part, plus 卩 (kneeling person): stopping and kneeling to lay down a load, to unload.

卸.name: unload

origin.says: Simplified from 屜: 尸 (here a seat or pad) with 世 (generation) as the sound part: a saddle pad, a tray, a drawer. The fuller build of 屜 is not clear.

烁.def: to sparkle, to shine, to glitter

ety.hint: The happy 乐 light of a flame 火

origin.says: Simplified from 爍: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 樂 (music, joy) as the sound: flickering, sparkling. 樂 is simplified to 乐.

烁.name: glitter

origin.says: 弟 (younger brother) as the sound plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: to shave. Possibly a later variant of another word for scraping.
A modern chemistry character: 气 (gas) for the meaning plus 安 (peace) for the sound 'an' of 'ammonia'.

ety.hint: Made whole 全 after an illness 疒; 全 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 全 (whole) as sound and meaning: made whole again after an illness, cured.
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 昷 (warm) as the sound: a feverish plague.

潇.def: the sound of beating wind and rain

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 萧 (bleak) as the sound: the sound of wind and rain beating down. Simplified from 瀟.

潇.name: driving rain

叮.def: to persistently exhort or urge; sting (as of an insect)

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 丁 (nail) as the sound: what a mouth does insistently, to urge again and again, or an insect's sting.

叮.name: sting

搅.def: to annoy, to disturb, to stir up

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 觉 (awaken) as the sound: to stir with the hand, to disturb. Simplified from 攪 along with 觉.

搅.name: stir

origin.says: One reading sees a drawing of a sprout swelling as it pushes out of the ground; others call the origin unclear. Its meanings 'to gather, garrison, village' are later uses.
𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 八 (eight) as the sound: to lie face down or lean forward on the body and limbs.

炫.def: to glitter, to shine; to show off, to flaunt

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 玄 (dark) as the sound: bright light that dazzles, and so to show off.

炫.name: show off

啃.def: to gnaw, to chew, to bite

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 肯 (willing) as the sound: to gnaw, as on meat on a bone.

啃.name: gnaw

origin.says: Built from 壺 (pot) with 吉 (lucky) inside as the sound: a sealed pot, single and whole, so 'one'. The inner part has changed into a shape like 冖 over 豆 (bean). Now the anti-fraud way to write 'one'.
武 (martial) as the sound plus 鸟 (bird) for the meaning: a kind of parrot. Simplified from 鵡 by writing 鳥 (bird) as 鸟.
婴 (infant) as the sound plus 鸟 (bird) for the meaning: the parrot. Simplified from 鸚, with the shells 贝 (shell) and the bird 鸟 (bird) in cursive-based shorthand.

ety.hint: To carve 钅 one's name 名; 名 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 金 (metal) plus 名 (name), which gives sound and meaning: a name carved in metal, to engrave. Simplified from 銘.

绷.def: to bind, to strap, to draw firm

origin.says: Simplified from 繃: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus a sound part: to bind tight, to stretch taut. The old sound part was 崩 (collapse); the simplified form uses 朋 (friend) instead.

绷.name: stretch taut

绵.def: continuous, unbroken; cotten, silk; soft, downy

ety.hint: A continuous thread 纟 of silk 帛

origin.says: Simplified from 綿, from older 緜: 糸 (silk thread) plus 帛 (silk cloth): fine silk floss, soft and drawn out without end. 糸 is written 纟.

绵.name: silk floss

琢.def: to polish jade; to cut jade

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 豖 (a hobbled pig) as the sound: to cut and polish jade, to refine.

琢.name: carve jade

origin.says: A modern chemistry character: 气 (gas) for the meaning plus 炎 (blaze), short for 淡 (dilute), as the sound: nitrogen, the gas that dilutes the air.

磕.def: to collide, to hit, to knock, to tap

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 盍 (lid, cover) as the sound: to knock against something hard.

磕.name: kowtow

origin.says: 算 (count) as the sound plus 厶 (private) for the meaning: taking power for oneself, to usurp. The bottom of 算 changes shape to make room for 厶.

ety.hint: A man 亻 who can support 支 someone

origin.says: 虫 (insect, small creature) for the meaning plus 旁 (side) as the sound: the crab, a creature that walks sideways.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 利 (profit) as the sound: a plant name, used in 茉莉 (jasmine).
豸 (beast) for the meaning plus 勺 (ladle) as the sound: 'leopard', the spotted beast. In oracle bones it was a drawing of the animal.
臼 (mortar) as the sound plus 男 (man) for the meaning: a male relative, the mother's brother.

喧.def: lively, noisy; to clamor, to talk loudly

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 宣 (proclaim) as the sound: loud talk, noisy.

喧.name: clamor

origin.says: Simplified from 鉛: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 㕣 (a sound part) as the sound: lead, the metal. 金 became 钅; the right part 㕣 now looks like 几 (small table) over 口 (mouth).
虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 文 (writing) as the sound: mosquito.

捣.def: to thresh, to pound; to stir, to disturb; to attack

origin.says: From 搗: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 島 (island) as the sound: to pound by hand; to stir up trouble. 島 became 岛.

捣.name: mash

ety.hint: A curtain 巾 at the entrance to a cave 穴

origin.says: An old character for the cloth banner outside a wine shop: 巾 (cloth) under 穴 (opening). Simplification made it also stand for 簾, 竹 (bamboo) plus 廉 as the sound, a bamboo blind or curtain.
